label: Restriction of content as limitation: the purity premises under one criterion (#2145 lane P)
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section 'When is a restriction of content a limitation? The purity premises under one criterion'. Lean: TruthCore/Causality/PurityCriteria.lean and TruthCore/Results/Causality/PurityCriteria/Solution.lean. Registered result da9f2d3c (argument b86a2364, zero-axiom main theorem actualRootFavouringIsGoodGeneralFromStandard): excluded middle, a30c5963, RootPurity c78c77da, the loss bridge 720bccc2, the arbitrariness bridge a141e6a8 and variation ca3c311d give horn A's conclusion 7fca65ec without e2357adc, 3e6ae3e7, joint compossibility, the admissible family or E. Comparator companions: standardControls (each premise load-bearing; row 6 is the D-relative form), standardRelativity (the D-directed and good-tracking profiles differ in genuine scenarios only on c over d at cBetter; the value bridges condemn the first and the D bridges the second there), refinementCondemnsGoodTracking (a value-free refinement criterion counts the good-tracking profile as restricted). Lean-only: exclusiveAlternativesNotBothPure and parAlternativeExcludedAtRoot (an intrinsic exclusive choice token on a par with its alternative is excluded at an unlimited root, personal or impersonal); variationForcesLossOrArbitrariness; hornAPremisesGiveVariation (horn A's premises entail the variation premise, so it is no extra cost); actualRootHasOneFavouringFromStandard (one favouring per actual root from the bridges, a bearer-level counterpart of 3e6ae3e7, not 3e6ae3e7); unionGoodGeneral and rowSevenUnionAndAbsence (the row-7 union is good-general; a D-only row-7 root has unexplained absences, so E returns); enumerativeRuleOvergeneralizes (the reference-class core for the reception fork); tensedOmniscienceExcludesImmutability and tenselessReading. Findings: (A) the locus criterion (a restriction of the profile versus a contingent selection outside it) is symmetric and independently motivated by a necessary root's world-invariant profile and contingent creation; it exempts the classical choice-specification and an impersonal permissive propensity alike. The measure criterion that classifies the ordinary cases correctly is standard-relative; its verdict on content-fixed favouring flips with the standard (value or end content), so e2357adc's warrant reduces to 'value is the measure of a root's favouring' plus variation within a D-class: a relocation. (B) Enumeration supports 'reception is constitutive' no better than 'finitude is constitutive'; the rival cannot hold the rule; the fork moves to a weak, non-decisive asymmetry for the mode reading of 44e39691. (C) The immutability candidate yields no pure-requires-pure-lack instance: reading (ii) has no conflict; under reading (i) the excluded determination is successive, impure under the stated open bridge that possession at one time and not another involves potency. (D) No derivation of composition from two favourings; denying 3e6ae3e7 costs the noncognitive rival the criterion or E. Rejected approaches: the value-free refinement criterion (misclassifies the will fixed on the good as such and condemns good-generality); the co-determinate criterion (decided by 3e6ae3e7 itself, and misclassifies the one-domain knower under the exclusive-profile analysis); variation among known instances as a test of constitutive features (cannot exempt finitude).
blocker: Not blocked for questions A-D under the stated assumptions. The measure question now turns on what fixes the standard of an original source's favouring (value, ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2, or its end content, ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1), and on goodness variation within a D-class; the reception fork on whether self-aboutness needs information transfer; the tensed-knowing reply on the open bridge that successive possession involves potency.

current_assessment.scope: Whether restriction of favouring content is a limitation (symmetric criterion, applied to the classical choice-specification); the reception fork as a reference-class test; immutability versus tensed knowing; one favouring per source
current_assessment.assessment: e2357adc remains open; its warrant is relocated to 'value is the measure of a root's favouring' plus goodness variation within a D-class. A symmetric locus criterion (profile restriction versus contingent selection) exempts the classical God's choice-specification and an impersonal permissive propensity alike without special pleading; the only tested measure criterion adequate on the ordinary cases is standard-relative, and on it the D-nature (value standard) or the good-tracking profile (D standard) is restricted, at parity in form. A lighter conditional support option for 7fca65ec (da9f2d3c) avoids e2357adc, 3e6ae3e7, joint compossibility and E. 44e39691: the constitutive side's enumerative support fails the reference-class test; weak, non-decisive asymmetry for the mode reading. 3e6ae3e7: no derivation as stated; its bearer-level counterpart follows from the standard bridges; its denial costs the noncognitive rival the criterion or E. The immutability candidate gives no pure-requires-pure-lack instance. No premise is established.
